##### Project general facts

Bab Al Qasr Royal 28 is an exclusive branded residential development by Burtville Developments, bringing the elegance of French-inspired architecture to a refined collection of one- to five-bedroom residences. Defined by grand arches, classical columns, and timeless proportions, the development embodies a philosophy of quiet luxury while offering spacious homes with impressive 3.6-metre slab-to-slab ceiling heights. Surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds covering 78% of the site, the project creates a sophisticated residential environment where traditional architectural beauty meets contemporary comfort.

Residents enjoy an exceptional collection of resort-style amenities, including two infinity pools, landscaped sky gardens, outdoor fitness and yoga areas, sports and paddle courts, children's play spaces, and elegant indoor lounges with coworking, library, and wellness facilities. As a Bab Al Qasr branded residence, homeowners also benefit from exclusive hotel privileges, including private beach and pool access, dining and spa discounts, and a range of on-demand hospitality services..

Each residence is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort, natural light, and timeless elegance through spacious layouts and premium materials. Interiors feature parquet wood flooring, natural marble, decorative wall finishes, wallpaper, and refined wooden accents, while bedrooms include built-in wardrobes and bathrooms are fitted with premium Roca sanitary ware. Semi-closed kitchens come fully equipped with Siemens appliances, and the residences are furnished with carefully selected pieces from THE One, complemented by Samsung televisions and OTIS elevators throughout the building. Delivered fully furnished, every home offers a luxurious turnkey living experience that reflects the exceptional quality and hospitality of the Bab Al Qasr brand.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island represents a dynamic intersection of modern ambition and natural tranquility. As one of Abu Dhabi’s most forward-looking districts, the island offers an environment where innovation, lifestyle, and waterfront serenity coexist. Its setting allows residents to enjoy expansive coastal views and green surroundings while remaining closely connected to the city’s evolving urban core, creating a balanced atmosphere that supports both productivity and relaxation.

The area benefits from excellent connectivity to key destinations across Abu Dhabi, placing educational institutions, business districts, healthcare services, retail centres, parks, and cultural landmarks within easy reach. This strategic accessibility simplifies daily routines and enhances quality of life, allowing residents to move seamlessly between professional commitments and leisure activities. The surrounding community is vibrant and well established, offering a comprehensive range of services and experiences that contribute to a convenient and well-rounded lifestyle.

In addition, the presence of nearby green spaces and landscaped parklands introduces a sense of openness and calm to everyday living. The island’s thoughtful urban planning encourages outdoor activity, social interaction, and family-friendly living, while its coastal character adds a refreshing dimension to the residential experience. Together, these qualities make Al Reem Island an appealing destination for those seeking a harmonious blend of city energy, natural beauty, and long-term livability.
